title: Minuta 2026-06-25
summary: The minutes of the 25 June meeting record a unanimous 5-0 hold at 6.50% with guidance to keep the rate at its current level, and the member-by-member section confirms a Board settled into a pause: no member argues for resuming cuts. The majority keeps the inflation risk balance tilted to the upside (some note it improved somewhat), stresses the persistence of services inflation and long-term expectations at their highest since March 2019, while also citing wide slack, fading supply shocks and peso strength as disinflationary forces. One member is clearly hawkish -- the real ex-ante rate reached neutral prematurely, policy must not fall below the neutral range, any further easing needs compelling evidence, and absent a rapid services slowdown the stance should stay put for a prolonged period -- while another leans dovish, stressing widening slack and working transmission, but only to call the current stance sufficient. Versus the May minutes, which recorded a divided Board delivering the last cut of the cycle, the discussion moves from how to end the easing to how long to hold; read against the same meeting's communique the minutes add texture but no different tilt, so the score matches it.

key_quotes.quote: Hacia delante, la Junta de Gobierno considera que será apropiado mantener la tasa de referencia en su nivel actual.
key_quotes.context: Collegial guidance: firm hold at the current level

key_quotes.quote: La mayoría consideró que el balance de riesgos respecto de la trayectoria prevista para la inflación en el horizonte de pronóstico mantiene un sesgo al alza.
key_quotes.context: Majority keeps the upside tilt, though some see it improving

key_quotes.quote: Indicó que la tasa real ex ante ha alcanzado el nivel estimado de la neutralidad de forma prematura y que ello no permite mayor relajación.
key_quotes.context: The lone hawk rules out further easing and wants a prolonged hold

key_quotes.quote: Agregó que la postura actual es lo suficientemente sólida para atender los riesgos que prevalecen en ambos lados del balance y para consolidar una convergencia sostenida de la inflación a la meta.
key_quotes.context: The most dovish member stresses widening slack and working transmission, but still endorses the hold
